text:
Elena (design): quick review: proposing a compact timeline "mini-scrubber" for version history that supports keyboard scrubbing and a lightweight preview token. want feedback on copy + a11y.
Omar: mini-scrubber is neat. question: does preview open a live preview session or just show metrics for that snapshot?
Elena (design): preview token opens a read-only preview session of the model version (no traffic change). label it "Preview session" to avoid confusion with rollbacks.
Priya (a11y): naming good. keyboard behaviour: arrow keys should move scrubber, Enter opens preview, Space opens action menu. ensure focus outline and aria-live announces version label and timestamp.
Will: implementation note: scrubbing currently triggers metric fetch per step which is heavy. debounce 200ms and show cached summary; fetch full preview content only on Enter.
Elena (design): microcopy: prefer "Preview session" (primary) + small help text "Inspect output without changing traffic". For rollback action use "Re-route traffic to this version" with helper "This will not delete historical data".
Omar: confirm flow: when user invokes rollback from timeline, we should show a modal with prefilled reason suggestions (standardized phrases) and optional note; require checkbox for >40% traffic shift.
Priya (a11y): modal focus: move to first interactive (reason select), trap focus, and return to the scrubber after close. also add role=status update after rollback success.
Will: will add aria-live polite for the success message and unit tests for focus order. debounce + cache for metrics on scrubber.
Elena (design): visual: when keyboard-scrubbing show a subtle persistent tooltip above the dot with version name + timestamp; ensure contrast AA. Also expose undo toast after apply with keyboard-focusable Undo.
Omar: add a small preview badge on the scrubber when preview session active, label it "Previewing" and include a close action.
Priya (a11y): make sure preview badge is reachable by keyboard and has descriptive label e.g., "Previewing v12, press enter to close". use aria-pressed for toggle semantics if applicable.
deploy-bot: preview build for branch "ux/mini-scrubber" at https://console.redwood.ai/preview/ux/mini-scrubber :white_check_mark:
Elena (design): thanks deploy-bot. next steps: Will to implement debounce + focus tests, Omar to wire preview session UI + rollback modal changes, Priya to run a11y pass on preview frames. I'll update Figma with tooltip + badge comps.
Priya (a11y): will check color contrast on tooltip and badge at small sizes. suggest darker token text if needed.
Will: will add keyboard-only visible labels for action items and a11y smoke tests. PR incoming.
Elena (design): great. aiming to ship in next sprint. thanks all :sparkles:
